clue.text: Amateur talent broadcast with tied turns

indicators.note: broadcast seed is scattered about, so the letters of the first word are strewn into a new order
turns says the letters of the second word are also twisted round, joining the same mixed pool

explanation.surface: An amateur performer's talent is shown on air alongside some joined-up acts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' and 'turns' both signal the anagram: TALENT and TIED together rearrange as one pool of ten letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A dabbler who takes up an art for pleasure rather than as a profession, a synonym for amateur.

clue.text: Boring spot around river

indicators.note: around says the word for a spot is wrapped about the river letter

parts.note: a dab is a small spot or smear of something

explanation.surface: A dull little place sits by a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Dull and colourless, lacking any interest: a straightforward synonym for boring.

clue.text: Get better following diet strictly

indicators.note: following places the recovery word after the diet word

parts.note: lite describes a low-calorie diet version of a food or drink
to rally is to recover or get better after illness

explanation.surface: Someone recovers from illness after sticking rigidly to a diet.
explanation.definitionFit: Taken strictly means read in the exact, word-for-word sense, which is what the answer means in careful usage.

clue.text: Hard liquor after time creates dull whine

indicators.note: after puts the hard spirit following the time letter

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
rum is a spirit, a strong liquor

explanation.surface: Drinking hard spirits late at night leads to a moaning drone.
explanation.definitionFit: A low continuous humming or droning sound, close to a dull whine.

clue.text: Shocks accepting sweetheart's approaches

indicators.note: accepting says the shocking word takes the heart letter inside it

parts.note: to appal is to shock or horrify
the heart, or central letter, of the word sweet is E

explanation.surface: A lover's advances provoke horror.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sweetheart' is the middle of 'sweet', E, a common crossword device.
explanation.definitionFit: Approaches as a noun means requests or pleas made to someone, the sense of appeals.

clue.text: Missile power contained by bomb discharge

indicators.note: contained by means the power letter sits inside the speeding word

parts.note: to bomb along is to tear along at speed; the clue needs the past tense, bombed, to give tore
P is the abbreviation for power, as in physics
to discharge a duty is to do it, to carry it out

explanation.surface: A rocket's energy is held inside a bomb that is about to be released.
explanation.walkthrough: This is a weak clue: 'bomb' has to give TORE, which really needs 'bombed' (raced), as Gazza pointed out on the Big Dave blog. 'contained by' puts P inside TORE, and DO comes after.
explanation.definitionFit: A torpedo is a self-propelled underwater weapon fired from a ship or submarine, a kind of missile.

clue.text: Go mad in retirement

indicators.note: in retirement means the word is drawn back, read from right to left

parts.note: bats is informal for mad or crazy

explanation.surface: Someone goes crazy after giving up work.
explanation.definitionFit: To have a go at something is to make an attempt, also called having a stab at it.

clue.text: Counts draw counting minutes and seconds

indicators.note: counting here means including, so the drawn game takes the minutes letter inside

parts.note: a tie is a drawn game

explanation.surface: A tied match is decided on minutes and seconds.
explanation.definitionFit: Times means occasions or instances, as when tallying counts of something happening.

clue.text: Growing container good to protect spur

indicators.note: to protect says the container and good letter surround the encouraging phrase

parts.note: a bin is a container
to urge on is to spur or encourage

explanation.surface: A growing plant pot guards the shoot from a spur.
explanation.definitionFit: Burgeoning means flourishing or expanding rapidly, a vivid synonym for growing.

clue.text: Offering support for church?

parts.note: read as a support for church offerings: the table in church on which sacrifices or the Eucharist are offered

explanation.definitionFit: The raised table in a church where offerings are placed is literally a support for church offerings.

clue.text: It's improper for merriment to grip actor

indicators.note: to grip says the words hold the answer inside them, run across the word breaks

explanation.surface: It is wrong for fun to take hold of a player on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor is one kind of entertainer who appears on stage.

clue.text: Old heads taking current drugs

indicators.note: taking means the old heads take the current letter inside

parts.note: pates are heads, especially bald tops of heads
I is the symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: Elderly people take modern medicine.
explanation.definitionFit: Opiates are narcotic drugs derived from opium.

clue.text: Search dodgy publication finding sleaze finally

parts.note: rum is informal for odd or dodgy
a mag is a magazine, a publication

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of the word sleaze

explanation.surface: A disreputable magazine hunts for scandal.
explanation.definitionFit: To rummage is to search untidily through things, a verb synonym for search.

clue.text: One's useless backing European debate

parts.note: one is I, and with its 's gives I'S

indicators.note: backing means the useless abbreviation is turned round

parts.note: U/S, short for unserviceable, means useless

explanation.surface: Someone is pointlessly supporting a European debate.
explanation.definitionFit: An issue is a matter in dispute, a topic for debate.

clue.text: Showman is more rapid, endlessly shuffling

indicators.note: shuffling mixes the letters like a deck of cards
endlessly removes the final letter of rapid

explanation.surface: A showman gets quicker and quicker, shuffling about non-stop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' trims RAPID to RAPI; 'shuffling' mixes IS, MORE and RAPI.
explanation.definitionFit: An impresario is a theatrical manager or promoter, a showman staging entertainments.

clue.text: Runs down motorway before signal changes

indicators.note: before puts the motorway letter ahead of the rest

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for motorway, as in the M1

indicators.note: changes signals the letters of signal are rearranged

explanation.surface: A car runs down the motorway before the lights change.
explanation.definitionFit: To run someone down is to criticise or speak ill of them, which is to malign.

clue.text: Manly nerve topping insect

indicators.note: topping in a down clue puts the nerve word above the insect

parts.note: gall is cheek or nerve
an ant is an insect

explanation.surface: A brave man has the nerve to kill an insect.
explanation.definitionFit: Gallant means brave and chivalrous, qualities traditionally called manly.

clue.text: Extravagant chap purchases love seat

indicators.note: purchases means getting a grip on, so the extravagant chap holds love between his parts

parts.note: OTT, over the top, means extravagant
a man is a chap
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A lavish spender buys a two-person sofa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'love seat' looks like one item, but love gives O and 'seat' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An ottoman is a low upholstered seat or footstool without a back.

clue.text: Significant this compiler's British in spirit

parts.note: the compiler refers to themself as me

indicators.note: in places the British letter within the spirit word

parts.note: morale is team spirit

explanation.surface: The setter boasts of being British at heart.
explanation.definitionFit: Something memorable is noteworthy and worth remembering, hence significant.

clue.text: Performance payment for Queen?

definitions.meaning: a fee paid to an author or composer each time a work is performed or sold
a queen is an example of a monarch, a member of the reigning family

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a fee paid to creators per use and the members of a monarch's family.

clue.text: Cries about nothing and wife colours

indicators.note: about says the cries are wrapped round the other letters

parts.note: yells are loud cries
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone shouts about having no wife and painting.
explanation.definitionFit: Yellows are shades of one colour, so they are colours.

clue.text: No stamp? He won't deliver!

parts.note: a mail carrier refuses a letter without a stamp; the letters of the opening two words also rearrange to the answer, though nothing signals it

explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads as a cryptic definition; its first two words happen to be an anagram of the answer, but no word here signals the rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: The one who brings the mail will not carry an unstamped letter, which pins down the job.

clue.text: Papers specifically for gift

parts.note: the press is the newspapers collectively
i.e., id est, introduces something stated specifically

explanation.surface: Newspapers are named as the present.
explanation.definitionFit: Pressie is informal British slang for a present or gift.

clue.text: Symbol in Greek, merely alphabetical initially

definitions.text: Symbol in Greek, merely alphabetical initially

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of each of the preceding words

explanation.surface: A Greek letter is just a matter of the alphabet.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines and supplies the letters at once: a symbol in the Greek alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: The eighteenth letter of the Greek alphabet, a symbol used in mathematics for summation.

clue.text: Incising exterior in purchased leg of lamb

indicators.note: in places those outer letters inside the purchased word

parts.note: got means obtained or purchased

indicators.note: exterior picks the outside letters of incising

explanation.surface: A butcher carves the outside of a bought joint.
explanation.definitionFit: A gigot is a leg of mutton or lamb, a French culinary term.

clue.text: More dubious seeing Left more sinister

parts.note: eerier means more strange and sinister

explanation.surface: Someone grows more suspicious on finding the left even more threatening.
explanation.definitionFit: Leerier is the comparative of leery, wary or suspicious, so more doubtful.

clue.text: River current almost directly south

parts.note: in means fashionable or current

indicators.note: almost drops the last letter of the word for directly

parts.note: due means directly, as in due north

explanation.surface: A river's current flows almost straight south.
explanation.definitionFit: The Indus is a major river of Pakistan, flowing to the Arabian Sea.

clue.text: Dead rodent causing bother

parts.note: a rat is a rodent

explanation.surface: A dead rat in the house is a nuisance.
explanation.definitionFit: Drat is a mild exclamation of annoyance, like bother used as an interjection.

clue.text: This rogue turned out honest

indicators.note: turned out signals that the letters are turned into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A villain proves to be upright after all.
explanation.definitionFit: Righteous means morally upright and virtuous, close to honest.

clue.text: Stop sweetheart embracing bachelor

indicators.note: embracing says the sweetheart word holds the bachelor letter inside

parts.note: dear is a term of endearment for a sweetheart

explanation.surface: A lover blocks a single man with a hug.
explanation.definitionFit: To debar is to bar or prevent someone from doing something, hence stop.

clue.text: Wildly sown they could produce seed!

definitions.text: Wildly sown they could produce seed!

parts.words: Wildly sown they could produce seed!
parts.note: plays on the idiom of sowing wild ..., youthful promiscuity that might produce offspring, as well as the literal cereal grain sown in fields

explanation.walkthrough: To sow one's wild oats is an idiom for a young man's promiscuous fling, so 'seed' means children as well as grain.
explanation.definitionFit: Cereal grains that are sown and yield seed, and the crop in the idiom about youthful excess.

clue.text: Buffoons broadcast about primarily motor testing

parts.note: asses are fools or buffoons

indicators.note: about wraps the broadcast word round the first letter

parts.note: sent means transmitted or broadcast

indicators.note: primarily picks the first letter of motor

explanation.surface: Clowns broadcast on the subject of a car's MOT examination.
explanation.definitionFit: An assessment is an evaluation or test, the noun matching testing as a process.
